title: Introduction to Biotechnology for New Majors and Transfer Students
description: This course will explore the historical perspectives, current applications, and future directions of biotechnology. The course will consist of informal lectures and interactive discussions led by Agricultural and Medical Biotechnology faculty and visiting professionals. The course will also orient students to the educational/career opportunities in Biotechnology and assist them in developing a focus for their degree programs.
prerequisites: Enrollment in the Agricultural and Medical Biotechnology program, at least 30 earned credit hours
